sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: terraced markets, goat stables, ridge inns, windmills, stonecutters, slope farms, and hilltop watch posts.

Market structure: grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.
Availability rule: Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: river docks, canal markets, reedcraft shops, ferry inns, fish smokehouses, water mills, and boatwright yards.

Market structure: grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.
Availability rule: Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: canopy markets, covered walkways, medicinal gardens, insect-screen hostels, river skiffs, resin craft shops, and storm shelters.

Market structure: grand bazaars, embassy hostels, luxury hotels, master guild courts, royal hospitals, relic vaults, and regulated portal offices. Elite purchases include tiny plated courses, rare materials, signed masterwork goods, and private appointments.
Availability rule: Capitals have the broadest stock, elite appointments, rare goods, and strict records for dangerous goods.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: pressure-sealed guest halls, waterlock entries, coral markets, kelp farms, shellcraft stalls, submersible docks, and air-safe rooms for non-gilled guests.

Market structure: district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.
Availability rule: Cities have full permanent districts; almost every listed item can be purchased without waiting unless it is restricted.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules

Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Location Profile

Market structure: district markets, guild halls, hotels, armory rows, hospitals, restaurants, bazaars, and licensed arcane counters. Fine goods, rare goods, and commissioned masterwork services are common.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: underground halls, mine-rail stations, fungal farms, forge markets, crystal elevators, warm vents, cavern hostels, and tunnel stables.
Market structure: town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.
Availability rule: Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

sections.heading: Location Profile

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: river docks, canal markets, reedcraft shops, ferry inns, fish smokehouses, water mills, and boatwright yards.
Market structure: town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.
Availability rule: Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

sections.heading: Location Profile
paragraphs: Biome identity: stilt markets, poleboat rentals, peat fires, reed houses, leech doctors, mosquito-net inns, and marsh guide camps.
Market structure: town market square, guild street, stable yard, tavern row, clinic, smithy, and craft halls. Luxury goods are available in small batches or by commission.
Availability rule: Towns have permanent shops for most goods, with rare and masterwork goods handled by guild commission.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

paragraphs: Biome identity: open markets, riding yards, caravan circles, ranch stores, grain halls, hunting camps, and wide-road taverns.
Market structure: small common market, hearth inn, livery yard, herb counter, smith stall, and traveling peddlers. Rare luxury goods require ordering through a caravan factor.

Availability rule: Villages list the same categories so the DM has a designated place for every purchase, but rare items are special orders, traveling-stall stock, shrine stock, or one-at-a-time commissions.
Currency: 1 pp = 10 gp; 1 gp = 10 sp; 1 sp = 10 cp; 1 ep = 5 sp and is uncommon.

Meal portions and prices intentionally scale by settlement type: villages and towns serve larger practical portions, while cities and capitals add costly fine dining, tiny luxury courses, private rooms, rare ingredients, and formal service.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: Strict Placement Rules
sections.text_excerpt: Strict Placement Rules Meal items are sold through hostels, taverns, inns, restaurants, hotels, tea houses, cafes, and market food stalls. Bulk food is sold through general stores, granaries, grocers, and marketplaces. Weapons, armor, ammunition, shields, and thundercoil gear are sold through armories, with repair and forged basics also handled by blacksmiths. Craft goods are placed in specific craft shops: leatherworkers, tailors, textile shops, carpenters, furniture halls, potters, glassblowers, tinkers, locksmiths, wheelwrights, bowyers, chandlers, and artists. Stables sell, rent, treat, and board mounts; wagonwrights and caravan yards handle carts, wagons, freight, and guards. Potions, elixirs, licensed Cannabis remedies, poisons, antitoxins, acids, and alchemical goods are sold through apothecaries, herbalists, alchemists, clinics, hospitals, temple clinics, or licensed poison counters. Mechanical, steam-driven, alchemical, and arcane-steam goods use designated craft, armory, alchemist, or guild counters.

sections.heading: DM Use Notes
paragraphs: Use these tables as the settlement shopping floor. The same item always has a designated location, so players know where to go and what kind of scene they are entering. Increase or decrease stock by neighborhood, danger rating, scarcity, guild politics, holy days, blockades, monster pressure, or local corruption.
All names are plain English except setting terms such as thundercoil. Merge notes and audit wording have been removed from this player-facing version.
